title: France: packaging Triman marking
summary: A producer placing packaged household goods on the French market must apply the Triman sorting marking with its Info-tri instructions.

sources.title: Code de l'environnement — Art. L541-9-3 (Légifrance)
sources.note: Corrected the URL during sign-off: the draft's pasted link (LEGIARTI000043974960) actually resolves to L541-10-1, not L541-9-3 — the two share a page family on Légifrance and it's an easy mix-up. This URL is L541-9-3's own article page. Direct fetch of legifrance.gouv.fr was blocked by its bot-check page; text below is quoted verbatim from Légifrance's own page via search, not from memory, but could not be re-fetched to double check today — re-verify with a browser before relying on this for the live catalog. FINDING: the Triman-marking duty is established in article L541-9-3 ('Tout produit mis sur le marché à destination des ménages soumis au I de l'article L. 541-10... fait l'objet d'une signalétique...'). SIGNED OFF 2026-09-20 (Tabeen Raoof) on this basis, split out of the former single fr.epr.packaging-citeo row to keep the catalog's one-requirement-one-citation convention; the manual browser re-check of the Légifrance text is still outstanding.
